title: Tier-1 tensor ops utility
objective: Implement low-level Taichi math helpers: matrix multiply, transpose multiply, PK transforms, det/inv helpers.

plan_assets.asset_description: Taichi @ti.func tensor operations library (mat_mul_33, mat_mul_T_33, pk1_from_pk2, cauchy_from_pk1, right_cauchy_green, det_33, inv_33)

implementation_steps: Implement mat_mul_33(A, B) -> A @ B as @ti.func
Implement mat_mul_T_33(A, B) -> A^T @ B as @ti.func
Implement pk1_from_pk2(F, S) -> F @ S as @ti.func
Implement cauchy_from_pk1(P, F, J) -> (1/J)(P @ F^T) as @ti.func
Write deterministic unit tests for identity, shear, random invertible matrices
deliverables: Unit tests for all tensor ops
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic unit tests pass for identity matrix
Deterministic unit tests pass for simple shear
Deterministic unit tests pass for random invertible matrices

cases: Random invertible: inv(A) @ A ≈ I to 1e-12

risks: Taichi JIT compilation may be slow for tests — mark with @pytest.mark.slow if needed
